Walkthrough

The Gemini adapter now reports `MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL` and `LANGUAGE` finish reasons as `RUN_ERROR` events with corresponding error codes and usage. Tests and documentation cover these outcomes. **Changes: Gemini finish reason handling** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Map and report abnormal finish reasons**
`packages/ai-gemini/src/adapters/text.ts`, `packages/ai-gemini/tests/gemini-adapter.test.ts`, `docs/adapters/gemini.md`, `.changeset/gemini-abnormal-finish-reason.md`|The adapter maps `MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL` and `LANGUAGE` to error details and emits `RUN_ERROR` with usage. Tests assert that these reasons do not produce `RUN_FINISHED`. Documentation and a patch changeset record the outcomes.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes **Change:** Bug fix **Possibly related PRs** - [TanStack/ai#2124](https://github.com/TanStack/ai/pull/2124): Updates the Gemini adapter’s terminal-event handling for streams that end without a `finishReason`; both changes define abnormal stream outcomes. **Suggested reviewers:** `alemtuzlak`, `tombeckenham`
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to bd30a

Gemini runs that end with a malformed function call or a language finish reason now surface an explicit error instead of appearing to stop normally. The change is small, follows the existing max-token behavior, and is covered by tests, so merge-readiness risk is minimal.
